description: This file defines the ThemeHandler class in Drupal, responsible for managing themes including listing, retrieving, and refreshing theme information, as well as handling theme dependencies and configurations.

classes.name: ThemeHandler
classes.description: Implements theme management functions such as listing, retrieving, and refreshing themes within Drupal.

methods.name: getDefault
methods.description: Returns the default theme as specified in the configuration.

methods.name: listInfo
methods.description: Returns an array of available themes, loading them if not already loaded.

methods.name: addTheme
methods.description: Adds a theme to the internal list, processing its libraries, engine, and base theme info.

methods.name: refreshInfo
methods.description: Refreshes theme information if themes are installed.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the theme list and reloads theme data.

methods.name: rebuildThemeData
methods.description: Deprecated method to rebuild theme data, triggers a deprecation warning.

methods.name: getBaseThemes
methods.description: Deprecated method to get base themes, triggers a deprecation warning.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a theme.

methods.name: getThemeDirectories
methods.description: Returns directories of all available themes.

methods.name: getTheme
methods.description: Retrieves a theme object by name or throws an exception if not found.

methods.name: hasUi
methods.description: Checks if a theme has a UI, considering hidden status and default/admin themes.
